text:
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: rel-2026.03.15-42 -> prod. Action: HOLD. Reason: incident redis-eu-p99-throttle (INC-4521). Will not progress until ops clears.

alex: Copy. Pausing rollout.

maria: We're restarting redis node eu-1 now, running sync->replica promotion. ETA ~12m.

ops-oncall: Restart started (reboot + warmup). Traffic rerouted to read-replicas, write queue draining. p99 currently 1.2s.

alex: Given this, propose reschedule to 2026-03-16 02:00 UTC and run canary in us-west first, then eu after stability. Thoughts?

jordan: +1 for us-west canary. Minimizes blast radius.

sam: I'll pin the release to rel-2026.03.15-42 so deploybot won't auto-retry. Also adding rollback commands to notes.

sam: rollback command for quick use: `deploy rollback rel-2026.03.15-42 --to rel-2026.03.14-09`

maria: Smoke test checklist I propose: 1) POST /health 2) short convo generation smoke 3) KV cache warmup 4) p50/p95/p99 check against baseline. I'll paste tests in a minute.

ops-oncall: Update: after restart p99 dropped to 180ms, p95 ~60ms. Metrics stable for last 2m but we'll keep hold for 30m to validate no regressions.

deploy-bot: Release rel-2026.03.15-42 status updated -> RESCHEDULE_CANDIDATE 2026-03-16T02:00:00Z. Auto-trigger disabled. Manual confirm required to resume.

alex: Sounds good. I'll confirm at +45m if metrics stay stable and then we can unpin and kick the us-west canary. Leaving the release pinned in the meantime. :thumbsup:

sam: Release notes updated: https://redwood.internal/releases/rel-2026.03.15-42 - pinned, rollback instructions, feature-flag toggle `foo_experiment` included.

maria: Pasted quick smoke plan in ops-docs channel. After confirm, canary -> 5% us-west, monitor for 15m, then 25%, then eu rollout if green.

jordan: ack. Thanks everyone.

alex: Closing loop: please add post-mortem blurb to the release notes about the incident and the hold decision (so PMs/CS are aware). I'll handle that after ops declares stable.
